content: Lower Respiratory Tract Infections: Acute Exacerbations of Chronic Bronchitis 1. Outpatient Management Patients presenting with only one of the three cardinal symptoms of COPD (increased dyspnea, increased sputum volume, or increased sputum purulence) may not benefit from antibiotic therapy. Preferred antibiotic regimens: 1. Doxycycline 100 mg orally twice daily for 7–10 days. 2. Amoxicillin 875 mg orally twice daily. 3. Amoxicillin 500 mg orally three times daily. 4. Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole DS (800/160 mg) orally twice daily for 10–14 days. Alternative regimens: 1. Amoxicillin-clavulanate 875/125 mg orally twice daily for 10–14 days. 2. Levofloxacin 500 mg orally once daily for 7–10 days. 3. Azithromycin 500 mg orally as a single dose, followed by 250 mg orally once daily for 4 days. 4. Cefpodoxime 200 mg orally twice daily for 10 days. 5. Amoxicillin-clavulanate 500/125 mg orally three times daily for 10–14 days. 6. Moxifloxacin 400 mg orally once daily for 5 days. 7. Gemifloxacin 320 mg orally once daily for 5 days. 8. Clarithromycin 250–500 mg orally twice daily for 7–14 days. 9. Clarithromycin ER 1000 mg orally once daily for 14 days. 10. Cefprozil 250–500 mg orally twice daily for 10 days. 11. Cefixime 400 mg orally once daily for 10 days. Bronchiectasis 1. Pediatric Dosing Amoxicillin: 20–50 mg/kg/day orally in two or three divided doses. Co-amoxiclav: 20–45 mg/kg/day orally in two or three divided doses. Trimethoprim: 4–6 mg/kg/day orally in two divided doses for children under 12 years. 100–200 mg orally twice daily for children over 12 years. Rifampicin: 450 mg orally once daily for patients weighing less than 50 kg. 600 mg orally once daily for patients weighing more than 50 kg. Vancomycin: 45–60 mg/kg/day intravenously every 8–12 hours. Ciprofloxacin: 15–30 mg/kg/day orally or intravenously every 12 hours. Doxycycline: 2–5 mg/kg/day orally or intravenously every 12–24 hours (maximum daily dose: 200 mg). Linezolid: 10 mg/kg intravenously or orally every 12 hours. Ceftriaxone: 50–75 mg/kg intravenously or intramuscularly every 24 hours. Ceftazidime: 150 mg/kg/day intravenously or intramuscularly every 8 hours. 2. Staphylococcus aureus (MSSA) Preferred regimen: Flucloxacillin 500 mg orally twice daily. Alternative regimen: Clarithromycin 250 mg orally twice daily. Bronchiolitis 1. Treatment Supportive care is the mainstay of treatment. Antimicrobial therapy is not recommended. 2. Acute Bronchitis Without Suspicion of Pertussis Supportive care is recommended. Antimicrobial therapy is not indicated. Empyema 1. Empiric Antimicrobial Therapy or Culture-Negative Therapy Common causative pathogens include: Streptococcus milleri, Streptococcus pneumoniae, Streptococcus intermedius, Staphylococcus aureus, Enterobacteriaceae, Escherichia coli, Fusobacterium spp., Bacteroides spp., and Peptostreptococcus spp. Preferred regimens: Piperacillin-tazobactam 4.5 g intravenously every 6 hours. Ampicillin-sulbactam 2/1 g intravenously every 6 hours. Meropenem 1 g intravenously every 8 hours or imipenem 500 mg intravenously every 6 hours. Note: Consider MRSA coverage if there is a high suspicion. Pneumonia 1. Presence of Comorbidities, Immunosuppressive Drug Use, or Recent Antimicrobial Use Preferred regimens: Levofloxacin 500 mg orally once daily for 7–14 days or 750 mg orally once daily for 5 days. Moxifloxacin 400 mg orally or intravenously every 24 hours for 7–14 days. Gemifloxacin 320 mg orally once daily for 5–7 days. Amoxicillin 1 g orally every 8 hours. Amoxicillin-clavulanate 1–2 g orally twice daily. Ceftriaxone 1–2 g intravenously every 24 hours. Cefpodoxime 200 mg orally twice daily for 14 days. Cefuroxime 750 mg intramuscularly or intravenously every 8 hours. Macrolide options: Azithromycin 500 mg orally as a single dose, followed by 250 mg orally once daily for 4 days. Clarithromycin 250 mg orally twice daily for 7–14 days or 1000 mg orally once daily for 7 days. Erythromycin 250–500 mg orally twice or three times daily (maximum daily dose: 4 g). Note: If recent antimicrobial therapy was used, select an alternative from a different class.
